create_standalone_draft_worker: create a StandaloneDraftWorker that initializes a draft model without sharing embeddings or lm_head with the target model
create_standalone_worker_v2: create a StandaloneWorkerV2 for EAGLE speculative decoding with a standalone draft worker and shared memory pool
get_plan_stream: get a CUDA stream context manager for overlapping plan stream computation when enabled via environment variable
